reviews.classification: phase supersession / missing gameplay wiring / later integration / historical authority
reviews.disposition:
Historical phase router under AD32/AD36/AD43. Read both the later implementation phase and original audit-only brief, all G1–G7 rows and closing dispatch qualification. The subsequent user instruction selects implementation and cross-group follow-through rather than leaving every group permanently audit-only. It does not make this router proof of completed gameplay, create current writers or authorize fresh chats today. Keep PC1–6 connected making, PC7–14 substitution, PC15–22 process, PC23–26 cross-craft, PC27–43 materials, PC44–53 environment and PC54–60 sources assigned to their existing reports/integration owners.

Original ACT NOW audit corrections and ACCOUNT/LATER proposals retain their status even after fitting implementation was selected: selection does not accept every mechanical expansion as a world law. Dated frozen procedural-audit counts are not current source or UI evidence. Producer/state/consumer, failure/recovery, persistence, observer knowledge and world distinctions remain the substantive review questions, not dispatch/report existence. The separate other-systems owner is not implicitly absorbed into these seven lanes. Old exclusive write areas, chat IDs and no-more-chats restrictions describe their phases; current file/source authority governs any new bounded work. This full router read inspects no linked seven report bodies, runtime, test or saved source. Existing group completion evidence stays in their own receipts; no metadata routing credit is substituted for it.

reviews.classification: phase supersession / missing gameplay wiring / later integration / historical authority
reviews.disposition:
Historical pure-module loader delivery under AD36/AD43. Read every manifest/load/population/save/fixture/invariant row and A1–A4/N1–N5. This lane explicitly has no gameplay wiring or browser evidence. Its62 focused tests, deliberately broken/reverted freeze-on-reveal check and1853 pass/3todo aggregate establish bounded source checks, not1856 passing tests or any played school. Synthetic341-person population,736560 queries and local budget/size figures are descriptive fixture measurements, not all-world cost or scale guarantees.

Manifest roles/axes/locks, membership-derived ordering, counterparts, lazy cohorts/draw records, per-instance pins and delta/migration/dormancy are separately implemented leaf contracts. They do not establish a current live Save/Export/Import owner merely because a helper section can serialize. INV2 is loader-visible and runtime INV7 remains unwired; do not flatten the listed invariant states into complete integration. Private-research refusal and license metadata are loader behavior at this identity, not a universal source-acquisition ban. Text-blind fingerprints and sealed-term lint are scoped sentinels, not proof of every indirect disclosure path.

Later P2, fully read in B486, records a distinct bundled MoL registry consumer and its own no-Cyoria-browser/revision-pin limits; that does not prove the proposed test-school population/save-delta path was wired. The WPL8a debug visit and its new saved-key compatibility are proposed future work in this checkpoint. Historical approval/owner checks cannot override later recorded user authority or manufacture a fresh permission loop, and old1366 viewport is not today's desktop matrix. Current source, candidate, locks and linked design/test bodies were not inspected by this full checkpoint review. Preserve the precise missing consumer rather than declaring all loaders absent or every leaf playable.

reviews.classification: phase supersession / missing gameplay wiring / later integration / historical authority
reviews.disposition:
Historical source-ready tool slice with later native evidence under AD36/AD42/AD43. This lane released five changed source/test paths; the sixth reserved panel test was unchanged. It did not build, run a full suite or perform native acceptance under the then LOTM lock. The [later master checkpoint](../master-reconciliation-2026-10-25/CHECKPOINT.md) records tool-native.cjs proof of actual mining-round cause, restart, forge diagnosis, cancel/refund, targeted repair retaining unrelated wear, five persistence checkpoints and four desktop/text cases. That later exact combined-input record owns its native proof and publication/adoption chronology, not this source-only lane. Its tool setup uses prepared practice/equipment/cave access rather than natural acquisition. Selected later checkpoint rows were inspected again for this link; no new current-runtime/artifact proof follows.

Preserve the mechanism and copy identity: optional opt-in cause resolves on actual completed mining work of that equipped copy; a physical defect changes real rates before diagnosis, without exposing hidden truth in player rows. The stop flag is not scalar condition zero or random punitive breakage. Diagnosis requires real means; targeted repair clears that defect while preserving unrelated wear/history/identity. Scalar/coin repair cannot silently remove typed damage. Cancellation/refused durable writes, stale targets, duplicate start/settlement and support loss have distinct expected effects; the existing native workCycle mutation seam does not establish new whole-tick atomicity.

Absent legacy fields, pending old wear jobs, durability-off freeze and optional schema1 state are the recorded compatibility decisions. Nineteen focused tests/JSON domain roundtrips were not native persistence by themselves. Authored cause, rates and20-minute/material values remain proposals, not source canon or universal damage taxonomy. Broader TQ130–141/layered TQ239 remain separate. Old build lock, coordinator custody and hashes are historical, not current reservation or re-execution instructions. This full receipt review reads no current source, generated fixture, private save or browser and changes no runtime.

reviews.classification: phase supersession / missing gameplay wiring / later integration / historical authority
reviews.disposition:
Mixed pause/resumption/campaign chronology under AD32/AD36/AD41/AD42/AD43. Read all later-scope banners and lower historical states. The bounded R15 G9 resumption and subsequent full W1 campaign authorization supersede the old blanket RESUME ONLY and paused paragraphs for their own stated scope. Later parent disposition records that campaign ended incomplete with gates open/unmerged at that check; old active-single-writer, branch/PID/worker and immediate C03 instructions do not establish a live owner or today's execution queue. Current project direction leaves Frontier/Mistglass as test beds and makes Klein-first the build focus, so retaining historical full-world authority does not restart a competing world campaign during this document reconciliation.

Preserve all S00–S14 open gates and3803 mixed accounting rows without a completion percentage. G9 provider leaves and C01/C02/integration are seeded-native, not natural acquisition or whole-section completion. Source test counts620/625/628 and their affected contracts/persistence groups bind different input identities; do not add or normalize them into a current universal suite. N5's broader regional conversation stays open. Ignored p09/p10 companions are required artifacts for the recorded root integration, not delivered by public code/docs alone. Frozen p01–p08 and immutable editions retain their ownership boundary.

The old1600×1100 desktop evidence is not present target-matrix proof. Director taste/human review is optional under AD42, separate from unresolved actual section/consumer evidence. Branch commits and main integration restrictions were that campaign's authority, not authorization for commits, source changes, new chats or installed-app writes now. This full checkpoint review reads no assignment/progress/capsule/private content, linked campaign reports, current branch or source body by implication. Recover any future selected task from its actual incumbent and current priorities, preserving old failures rather than asking for already recorded permission or treating the campaign as complete.
